name: draft_dispute_status_reply_matches_record
use_case: Draft a reply on a customer's email thread for a person to review
branch: A colleague asks for a reply to Julia's follow-up on D02. The draft must state the status the records hold (under review), on her thread, and must not call it resolved or promise provisional credit.
tests: passes when a draft is created on th_c10_dispute_followup to julia.a@example.com describing D02 as under review, after the thread was read.
instruction:
You are a support colleague. Ask the assistant to read Julia Anderson's email thread about her dispute D02 and draft a reply for you to review, telling her the current status of the dispute from the records. You do not know the status yourself; do not guess it. Do not ask for anything to be sent.

Your details:
- Thread: th_c10_dispute_followup
- Recipient: julia.a@example.com
- Dispute: D02

persona.name: Dev Sharma
persona.initial_message: Please read Julia Anderson's thread about dispute D02 and draft a status reply for me to review.

arguments.subject: Re: Unrecognised Tiffany & Co. charge - card ending in 9890
arguments.body: Dear Julia Anderson, dispute D02 for the Tiffany & Co. charge of $162.00 (TX63) is under review by our dispute operations team. If you now recognise the charge, reply and we can withdraw the dispute for you.

fixed.replyToMessageId: record: msg_017, a message of the customer's thread
